items.question: bridge lender
items.answer:
A bridge lender provides short-term finance (typically 1 to 24 months) secured against a property or asset . These loans are typically used to "bridge" financial gaps, such as buying a new home before selling your old one, securing an auction property, or funding renovations.[](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/b/bridgeloan.asp) [[1]](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/b/bridgeloan.asp)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/qcYiJLmZ4eE)[[3]](https://www.ennessglobal.com/insights/blog/need-funding-fast-how-property-bridge-loans-can-save-your-deal)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7xktXeK8Oa8&vl=en-GB)[[5]](https://www.westoneloans.co.uk/bridging-loans)In the UK, the market is divided into two main categories:[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6i3vdLlcFFA&t=7)

- **Regulated bridging loans:** Governed by the **FCA** , used when the borrower intends to live in the property.
- **Unregulated bridging loans:** Used by property investors and businesses for buy-to-lets, flipping houses, or commercial spaces.[](https://www.commercialtrust.co.uk/news/what-you-need-to-know-about-bridging-lenders/) [[1]](https://www.commercialtrust.co.uk/news/what-you-need-to-know-about-bridging-lenders/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6i3vdLlcFFA&t=7)

Leading UK-based bridge lenders and brokers offer specialized short-term funding with different criteria:[[1]](https://alternativebridging.co.uk/alternative-bridging-strengthens-broker-support-team-with-internal-bdm-recruitment-of-charlotte-wilson/)[[2]](https://www.equityone-bridgingloans.co.uk/faqs_eq.php)

- **Shawbrook:** Offers loans from £50k to £25m, up to 90% LTV, with terms up to 24 months.
- **MT Finance:** Delivers fast short-term finance for auction purchases, chain breaks, and equity release.
- **LendInvest:** Provides "Bridge-to-Let" options, allowing investors to bridge an immediate purchase and smoothly transition onto a standard Buy-to-Let mortgage.
- **West One Specialist Lending:** Provides first and second charge bridging up to 70% LTV, with rates typically starting around 0.90% per month.[](https://www.mt-finance.com/) [[1]](https://www.mt-finance.com/)[[2]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/bridging-loans/)[[3]](https://www.lendinvest.com/blog/everything-you-need-to-know-about-bridge-to-let-lending-in-the-uk/)[[4]](https://www.westoneloans.co.uk/bridging-loans)

To compare products across multiple lenders at once, you can use comparison platforms like the [Brickflow Bridging Loan Lenders](https://brickflow.com/bridging-loan-lenders) guide.[[1]](https://brickflow.com/brickflow-thinks/who-can-get-a-bridging-loan)[[2]](https://brickflow.com/brickflow-thinks/bridging-loan-interest-rates)[[3]](https://www.ennessglobal.com/insights/blog/need-funding-fast-how-property-bridge-loans-can-save-your-deal)To help narrow down the best lender and structure for your needs, could you tell me:

- What is the **purpose of the loan** (e.g., buying at auction, preventing a chain break, or funding property development)?
- What is the **estimated property value** and the **amount you need to borrow**?
- Is this property for your **personal residence** or a **business/investment**?

items.question: bridging lenders
items.answer:
Bridging lenders provide short-term, fast-access loans secured against property to bridge gaps in funding, typically for auctions, renovations, or chain breaks . Loans range from 1–24 months, with rates often starting around 0.79% per month, offering high Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios up to 85%. Options include regulated (residential) and unregulated (commercial/investment) loans.[[1]](https://bridgingloandirectory.co.uk/)[[2]](https://www.westoneloans.co.uk/bridging-loans)[[3]](https://www.lendinvest.com/mortgages/bridging-finance/)[[4]](https://www.ariafinance.co.uk/bridging-loans)[[5]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/bridging-loans/)[[6]](https://www.commercialtrust.co.uk/news/bridging-loan-regulated-or-unregulated/)

**Key Bridging Lenders in the UK**   
Several specialists dominate the UK bridging market, offering varied solutions:[[1]](https://brickflow.com/bridging-loan-lenders)[[2]](https://www.ukmortgageadvisors.co.uk/bridging-loans/best-bridging-lenders/)

- **[[LendInvest](https://www.google.com/search?q=LendInvest&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwj07cz2gqaUAxURcmwGHehSGlIQgK4QegQIAxAD) ](https://www.lendinvest.com/mortgages/bridging-finance/):** Known for large projects, development finance, and up to 85% LTV.
- **[[West One Loans](https://www.google.com/search?q=West+One+Loans&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwj07cz2gqaUAxURcmwGHehSGlIQgK4QegQIAxAG) ](https://www.westoneloans.co.uk/bridging-loans):** Specializes in refurbishment and quick capital access.
- **[[MT Finance](https://www.google.com/search?q=MT+Finance&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwj07cz2gqaUAxURcmwGHehSGlIQgK4QegQIAxAJ) ](https://www.mt-finance.com/bridging-loans/):** Focuses on fast, flexible solutions for residential and commercial property.
- **[Together Money](https://www.google.com/search?q=Together+Money&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwj07cz2gqaUAxURcmwGHehSGlIQgK4QegQIAxAL):** Handles complex cases and property deemed too risky by others.
- **[[Shawbrook Bank](https://www.google.com/search?q=Shawbrook+Bank&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwj07cz2gqaUAxURcmwGHehSGlIQgK4QegQIAxAO) ](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/bridging-loans/):** Offers tailored, non-regulated bridging with no early repayment charges.
- **[Apex Bridging](https://www.google.com/search?q=Apex+Bridging&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwj07cz2gqaUAxURcmwGHehSGlIQgK4QegQIAxAQ):** Specializes in high LTV and fast service.
- **[Alternative Bridging Corporation](https://www.google.com/search?q=Alternative+Bridging+Corporation&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwj07cz2gqaUAxURcmwGHehSGlIQgK4QegQIAxAS):** Provides a range of short-term property finance options.[[1]](https://brickflow.com/bridging-loan-lenders)[[2]](https://www.lendinvest.com/mortgages/bridging-finance/)[[3]](https://www.westoneloans.co.uk/bridging-loans)[[4]](https://www.mt-finance.com/bridging-loans/)[[5]](https://www.ukmortgageadvisors.co.uk/bridging-loans/best-bridging-lenders/)[[6]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/bridging-loans/)

**Types of Bridging Loans** 

- **Closed Bridging Loan:** Has a fixed repayment date (e.g., when a property sale completes). Often lower cost.
- **Open Bridging Loan:** No fixed repayment date, though usually expected within 12 months. Used when a property is for sale but no buyer is yet found.
- **Regulated vs Unregulated:** Regulated loans are for properties you or your family live in (FCA regulated). Unregulated loans are for investment/commercial properties.[[1]](https://bridgingloandirectory.co.uk/)[[2]](https://www.commercialtrust.co.uk/news/bridging-loan-regulated-or-unregulated/)[[3]](https://www.ukmortgageadvisors.co.uk/bridging-loans/best-bridging-lenders/)[[4]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/bridging-loans/)[[5]](https://www.moneysupermarket.com/loans/bridge-loans/)

**Key Considerations** 

- **Speed:** Funds can be secured in days or weeks, making them ideal for auction purchases.
- **Exit Strategy:** A clear plan to repay the loan is required, usually via sale or refinancing.
- **Costs:** Interest can be paid monthly or 'rolled up' (paid at the end), and fees often include application and valuation costs.[[1]](https://bridgingloandirectory.co.uk/)[[2]](https://www.ariafinance.co.uk/bridging-loans)[[3]](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/)[[4]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/bridging-loans/)[[5]](https://www.mortgagelane.com/mortgages/business-bridging-loans/)

items.question: specialized loan services
items.answer:
Specialized loan services offer bespoke financing solutions for unique financial needs that don't fit standard high street criteria, such as complex income structures, adverse credit history, or unique property investments. These include **bridging loans, development finance, second charge mortgages** , and **complex buy-to-let mortgages**.[](https://www.pepper.money/) [[1]](https://www.pepper.money/)[[2]](https://www.clsmoney.com/)[[3]](https://togethermoney.com/)[[4]](https://positivelending.co.uk/)[[5]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/business/specialist-lenders/)The UK specialist lending sector is highly dynamic, featuring specialist non-bank lenders, challenger banks, and dedicated brokers. Notable options include:[[1]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/business/specialist-lenders/)[[2]](https://bridgingfinance4u.co.uk/high-street-bank-vs-specialist-bridging-lender/)[[3]](https://www.ukfinance.org.uk/news-and-insight/blog/closing-gap-between-specialist-btl-demand-and-lender-capability)[[4]](https://www.beat-finance.co.uk/commercial)

- **Bridging & Property Development:** Firms like **[West One Loans](https://www.westoneloans.co.uk/)** provide short-term property finance and development loans, while **[Together](https://togethermoney.com/)** offers tailored bridging and commercial auction finance.
- **Complex Mortgages:** Lenders like **[Pepper Money](https://www.pepper.money/)** use human underwriting to consider individual circumstances rather than just credit scores.
- **Brokers & Whole-of-Market:** Specialist brokers such as **[Aria Finance](https://www.ariafinance.co.uk/)** and **[CLS Money](https://www.clsmoney.com/)** can scan the broader market to match your exact financial scenario with the right underwriter.
- **Private Banking:** For high-net-worth individuals, institutions like **[Lloyds Bank Private Banking](https://www.lloydsbank.com/private-banking/specialist-lending.html)** offer tailored specialist lending based on broader asset portfolios.[](https://www.lloydsbank.com/private-banking/specialist-lending.html) [[1]](https://www.lloydsbank.com/private-banking/specialist-lending.html)[[2]](https://www.enra.co.uk/)[[3]](https://togethermoney.com/)[[4]](https://www.pepper.money/)[[5]](https://www.ariafinance.co.uk/)[[6]](https://www.clsmoney.com/)

If you tell me more about your financing goals, I can help you narrow down your options. Let me know:

- What **type of loan** are you looking for (e.g., bridging, buy-to-let, commercial)?
- Do you have **any specific circumstances** to factor in (e.g., unusual property type, complex income)?

`Relations between the United Kingdom and Russia are at a historical low, defined by deep diplomatic freezes, heavy UK sanctions in response to the war in Ukraine, and direct naval interventions targeting Russian "shadow fleet" oil tankers`.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6QraVgMSn5o) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6QraVgMSn5o)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/government/topical-events/russian-invasion-of-ukraine-uk-government-response)[[3]](https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-hits-russia-with-fresh-energy-sanctions-at-g7/)[[4]](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20yzm84r7lo)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russia%E2%80%93United_Kingdom_relations)The situation across several key areas currently stands as follows:1. Direct Military and Maritime Encounters

- **Shadow Fleet Interception:** British forces, including the Royal Navy and RAF, directly intercepted and boarded a sanctioned Russian shadow fleet oil tanker in UK waters. These "ghost ships" are heavily utilized by Russia to bypass international sanctions and fund their war efforts.[](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20yzm84r7lo) [[1]](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20yzm84r7lo)[[2]](https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-hits-russia-with-fresh-energy-sanctions-at-g7/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6QraVgMSn5o)
- **English Channel Incidents:** Tensions remain high in the maritime corridor, with incidents such as a Russian warship firing warning shots near a UK-registered yacht off the Isle of Wight.[](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20yzm84r7lo) [[1]](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20yzm84r7lo)[[2]](https://news.sky.com/story/what-we-know-about-russian-warship-that-fired-warning-shots-in-english-channel-13554751)

2. Sanctions and Support for Ukraine

- **Energy Embargos:** The UK announced fresh energy sanctions targeting Russia's illicit shipping networks and embargoed vessels moving liquified natural gas (LNG).[](https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-hits-russia-with-fresh-energy-sanctions-at-g7/) [[1]](https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-hits-russia-with-fresh-energy-sanctions-at-g7/)
- **Nuclear Contracts:** Prime Minister Keir Starmer brokered a £210 million deal via UK Export Finance for British-based company Urenco to supply enriched uranium to Ukraine's nuclear reactors.[](https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-hits-russia-with-fresh-energy-sanctions-at-g7/) [[1]](https://www.politico.eu/article/uk-hits-russia-with-fresh-energy-sanctions-at-g7/)

3. Travel Warnings and Dual Nationals

- **High Risk of Detention:** The UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) advises against all travel to Russia. British nationals face a severe risk of arbitrary arrest, with authorities utilizing foreign detainees as geopolitical leverage.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia)
- **Dual National Warning:** British-Russian dual nationals are particularly at risk. Those traveling to renew Russian passports often get trapped due to bureaucratic delays and strict departure regulations, with the FCDO offering extremely limited ability to assist.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia)[[2]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia/entry-requirements)

4. Foreign Influence and Cyber Security

- **Cyber Threats:** UK intelligence continually warns that Russian state actors relentlessly target the UK's democratic processes, infrastructure, and institutions through cyber operations and covert influence.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G93uQ2gPhDE) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G93uQ2gPhDE)[[2]](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/business/2026/05/30/british-voters-are-deluded-comes-defence-spending/)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/p/DY2AWNXoPjC/)
- **Foreign Influence Registration:** To combat this, the UK has clamped down on covert activities, mandating the Foreign Influence Registration Scheme requiring anyone acting on behalf of the Russian state to register publicly or face prosecution.[](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/russia-to-be-placed-on-foreign-influence-registration-scheme) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/russia-to-be-placed-on-foreign-influence-registration-scheme)

High-paying jobs requiring no prior experience in the UK often include roles in `sales, logistics, specialized trades, and healthcare support` , frequently offering on-the-job training. Examples include sales executives, recruitment consultants, HGV drivers, estate agents, offshore energy technicians , and support workers , with salaries often exceeding £30,000 to £40,000+.[[1]](https://www.ncchomelearning.co.uk/blog/high-paying-jobs-with-no-experience/#:~:text=Finding%20Comfort%20With%20Remote%20Work,Sources)[[2]](https://uk.indeed.com/q-no-experience-necessary-30k-jobs.html)[[3]](https://uk.indeed.com/q-no-experience-%C2%A340,000-l-london-jobs.html#:~:text=Volunteer%20Work%20Teaching%20Assistant%20jobs,Cleaner%20jobsAll%20Sander%20jobs)

Top High-Paying Jobs No Experience

- **Sales Executive/Business Development:** Many companies offer high base salaries plus uncapped commission.
- **Recruitment Consultant:** Known for high commission potential; focuses on hiring, training, and matching candidates to roles.
- **Estate Agent:** Involves property viewings and sales, with earnings heavily boosted by commission.
- **HGV/Delivery Driver:** High demand for drivers (often with training provided) and courier roles.
- **Offshore Energy Technician:** Entry-level roles in the energy sector, particularly in offshore wind or oil.
- **Trading/Broker Support:** Administrative roles in finance that can lead to high-level positions.

Key Industries Hiring Without Experience

- **Technology:** Data entry, IT support, or junior developer roles.
- **Logistics & Transport:** Warehouse operatives, courier drivers, and transport coordinators.
- **Hospitality & Events:** Barbacks, waiting staff, and event planners.[[1]](https://www.ncchomelearning.co.uk/blog/high-paying-jobs-with-no-experience/#:~:text=Finding%20Comfort%20With%20Remote%20Work,Sources)[[2]](https://www.skill-up.org/high-paying-entry-level-jobs/)[[3]](https://uk.indeed.com/q-high-pay-no-experience-jobs.html#:~:text=High-paying%20Hospitality%20and%20Tourism,Proctor%20jobsAll%20Sander%20jobs)[[4]](https://uk.indeed.com/q-high-pay-no-experience-l-leicester-jobs.html)[[5]](https://www.indeed.com/career-advice/finding-a-job/high-paying-jobs-without-degree-or-experience)

items.question: uk bridging finance
items.answer:
A bridging loan is a temporary, short-term loan used to "bridge" a funding gap . It is typically secured against a valuable asset like property. In the UK, loans range from£2 5,0 0 0 to£5 0 0 million, with terms lasting from a few weeks up to three years.[](https://www.experian.co.uk/consumer/loans/guides/bridging-loans.html) [[1]](https://www.experian.co.uk/consumer/loans/guides/bridging-loans.html)[[2]](https://www.ennessglobal.com/insights/blog/bridging-finance-in-the-uk)[[3]](https://www.moneysupermarket.com/loans/bridge-loans/)[[4]](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/)Common uses for bridging finance include:

- **Buying at auctions:** Securing fast funds when a quick completion is required.
- **Chain breaks:** Buying a new home before your current one sells.
- **Refurbishment:** Fixing up unmortgageable properties before selling or renting.[](https://www.experian.co.uk/consumer/loans/guides/bridging-loans.html) [[1]](https://www.experian.co.uk/consumer/loans/guides/bridging-loans.html)[[2]](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/)[[3]](https://abcfinance.co.uk/bridging-loans/)[[4]](https://www.gocompare.com/loans/bridging-loans/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HCbaXpbCwD0)

Bridging loans can be **regulated** or **unregulated**.[](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/) [[1]](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/)[[2]](https://abcfinance.co.uk/bridging-loans/)

- **Regulated:** Used when you or your family will live in the property. It is regulated by the **FCA (Financial Conduct Authority)**.
- **Unregulated:** Used for business, commercial, or investment properties where the borrower does not live.[](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/) [[1]](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/)[[2]](https://www.ennessglobal.com/insights/blog/bridging-finance-in-the-uk)[[3]](https://abcfinance.co.uk/bridging-loans/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Im1yZIaX6qc&t=66)

How the loan works:

1. **LTV (Loan-to-Value):** Lenders look at the property's value and typically lend up to 75% of it.[](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/) [[1]](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/)
2. **Interest:** You don't have to make monthly payments. The interest is usually "rolled up" and paid as a lump sum at the end. Expect rates from about 0.47% to 1.5% per month.[](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/) [[1]](https://www.kisbridgingloans.co.uk/bridging-loan/)[[2]](https://www.utbank.co.uk/lending/bridging-finance/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ULW1FpvbH4Y&t=39)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/qcYiJLmZ4eE)[[5]](https://www.ennessglobal.com/insights/blog/bridging-finance-in-the-uk)
3. **Exit Strategy:** You **must** have a clear plan to repay the loan at the end of the term, such as selling the property or securing a long-term mortgage.[](https://www.utbank.co.uk/lending/bridging-finance/) [[1]](https://www.utbank.co.uk/lending/bridging-finance/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ULW1FpvbH4Y&t=39)[[3]](https://abcfinance.co.uk/bridging-loans/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HCbaXpbCwD0)

items.question: meaning of cim
items.answer:
The acronym **CIM** has `several common meanings depending on the context`:

- **Business & Finance:** Confidential Information Memorandum (a document used to sell a business).
- **Marketing:** The Chartered Institute of Marketing.
- **Technology:** Computer-Integrated Manufacturing or Common Information Model.[](https://www.cim.co.uk/) [[1]](https://www.cim.co.uk/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4hkw6QTWUFw)[[3]](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cim)[[4]](https://www.splunk.com/en_us/blog/learn/cim-common-information-model.html)


---

Business & Finance: Confidential Information Memorandum (CIM)

In mergers and acquisitions (M&A), a CIM is a detailed, 20-to-30-page document created by an investment banker or business broker. It provides potential buyers with a comprehensive overview of the target company's operations, financial history, management team, and market position so they can make an informed bid.[](https://corporatefinanceinstitute.com/resources/valuation/cim-confidential-information-memorandum/) [[1]](https://corporatefinanceinstitute.com/resources/valuation/cim-confidential-information-memorandum/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4hkw6QTWUFw)[[3]](https://www.duedilio.com/what-is-a-confidential-information-memorandum-cim/)[[4]](https://www.wallstreetprep.com/knowledge/confidential-information-memorandum-cim-example-pdf-download/)[[5]](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cim)

- *Also known as:* Offering Memorandum or Information Memorandum.[](https://corporatefinanceinstitute.com/resources/valuation/cim-confidential-information-memorandum/) [[1]](https://corporatefinanceinstitute.com/resources/valuation/cim-confidential-information-memorandum/)

Marketing: The Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM)Based in the UK, the [CIM](https://www.cim.co.uk/) is the world's leading professional marketing body. It sets industry standards, provides professional qualifications, and supports marketers with resources and career development.[](https://www.cim.co.uk/) [[1]](https://www.cim.co.uk/)[[2]](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cim)[[3]](https://wedomarketing.co.uk/what-is-a-cim-membership/)Technology: Computer-Integrated Manufacturing (CIM)CIM is an approach to manufacturing in which computers and automation control the entire production process—from design and planning to purchasing and distribution.[](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cim) [[1]](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cim)[[2]](https://www.armagard.com/ip54/computer-integrated-manufacturing-explained-clearly.html)Technology: Common Information Model (CIM)In IT and cybersecurity, the [Common Information Model (CIM)](https://www.splunk.com/en_us/blog/learn/cim-common-information-model.html) is a vendor-neutral framework that normalizes data from various sources (like logs) into consistent, standardized formats. This allows systems to search, report, and analyze data efficiently across multiple platforms.[](https://www.splunk.com/en_us/blog/learn/cim-common-information-model.html) [[1]](https://www.splunk.com/en_us/blog/learn/cim-common-information-model.html)

Terry Smith is an English fund manager, author, and the founder and CEO of the investment firm Fundsmith. Often dubbed "the English Warren Buffett," he is known for his strict "buy and hold" investment strategy, which focuses on high-quality, resilient companies with strong balance sheets and high returns on capital.[](https://quartr.com/insights/investment-strategy/get-to-know-terry-smith) [[1]](https://quartr.com/insights/investment-strategy/get-to-know-terry-smith)[[2]](https://www.fundsmith.co.uk/news/archive/?terry-smith)[[3]](https://www.moneymazepodcast.com/podcast/terry-smith)[[4]](https://quartr.com/insights/investment-strategy/get-to-know-terry-smith)Fundsmith and Investment Philosophy Terry Smith established Fundsmith in 2010 with a philosophy centered around three simple rules: buy good companies, don't overpay, and do nothing. The flagship Fundsmith Equity Fund has grown into one of the largest and most popular retail funds in the UK.[](https://www.moneymazepodcast.com/podcast/terry-smith) [[1]](https://www.moneymazepodcast.com/podcast/terry-smith)[[2]](https://quartr.com/insights/investment-strategy/get-to-know-terry-smith)[[3]](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/insider/terry-smiths-fundsmith/)[[4]](https://www.fundsmith.co.uk/news/archive/?p=2&terry-smith)His strategy specifically avoids certain types of investments, such as highly cyclical businesses, banks, and companies driven by fads. Instead, he prioritizes established businesses with strong intellectual property, solid brand presence, and reliable cash flows.[](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/hh3_eZYORvA) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/hh3_eZYORvA)[[2]](https://www.panmacmillan.com/authors/terry-smith/48467)[[3]](https://www.moneymazepodcast.com/podcast/terry-smith)Career Background Before launching Fundsmith, Smith built a prominent career in finance:

- **Analyst & Author:** In the 1980s, he was the top-rated bank analyst in London. He gained widespread notoriety (and lost his job at UBS) following the 1992 publication of his bestselling book, *Accounting for Growth* , which exposed how many companies "cook the books" to flatter their earnings.[](https://quartr.com/insights/investment-strategy/get-to-know-terry-smith) [[1]](https://quartr.com/insights/investment-strategy/get-to-know-terry-smith)[[2]](https://www.panmacmillan.com/authors/terry-smith/48467)[[3]](https://www.fundsmith.co.uk/news/archive/?terry-smith)
- **Brokerages:** He served as CEO of Collins Stewart and later Tullett Prebon, transforming them into globally significant inter-dealer brokers before leaving in 2014 to focus exclusively on Fundsmith.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terry_Smith_%28businessman%29) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terry_Smith_%28businessman%29)[[2]](https://www.panmacmillan.com/authors/terry-smith/48467)

Recent Developments and Insights Smith continues to manage Fundsmith while navigating shifting market environments. He also serves as the manager for the Smithson Investment Trust, which has undergone restructuring to transition into an open-ended fund.[[1]](https://citywire.com/new-model-adviser/news/terry-smiths-earnings-could-top-100m-despite-fundsmith-faltering/a2478865)[[2]](https://www.investmentweek.co.uk/news/4521724/saba-activism-bears-fruit-terry-smiths-18bn-smithson-proposes-oeic-rollover)[[3]](https://quartr.com/insights/investment-strategy/get-to-know-terry-smith)To understand Terry Smith's core philosophy on identifying strong, enduring businesses with long-lasting intangibles:![](https://api.dataforseo.com/llm_m/cdn/i/1578688138093992772:92d7aa58e398a77a65da835bfa19a334)

[Close Brothers Group](https://www.closebrothers.com/) is a leading UK merchant banking group established in 1878, providing lending, deposit-taking, and securities trading services. Listed on the FTSE 250, it focuses on specialist finance for SMEs and individuals, with around 3,000 employees primarily in the UK and Ireland.[[1]](https://www.closebrothers.com/who-we-are#:~:text=A%20UK%20specialist%20banking%20group,on%20the%20London%20Stock%20Exchange.)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Close_Brothers_Group#:~:text=Close%20Brothers%20Group%20plc%20is,of%20the%20FTSE%20250%20Index.)[[3]](https://www.closesavings.co.uk/)

**Key Divisions and Services** 

- **[Banking](https://www.google.com/search?q=Banking&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwjk-N62y8aTAxWVTaQEHRGIJrQQgK4QegQIAxAB):** Provides secured lending through Commercial (asset finance, invoice finance), Retail (motor finance, premium finance), and Property divisions.
- **[Savings](https://www.google.com/search?q=Savings&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwjk-N62y8aTAxWVTaQEHRGIJrQQgK4QegQIAxAD):** Offers competitive personal and business savings accounts, protected by the [Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS)](https://www.closesavings.co.uk/).
- **[Winterflood](https://www.google.com/search?q=Winterflood&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwjk-N62y8aTAxWVTaQEHRGIJrQQgK4QegQIAxAG):** A leading market maker and liquidity provider.
- **[Asset Management](https://www.google.com/search?q=Asset+Management&csui=3&hl=en&gl=GB&uule=w+CAIQIFISCamRx0IRO1oCEXoliDJDoPjE&ved=2ahUKEwjk-N62y8aTAxWVTaQEHRGIJrQQgK4QegQIAxAI):** Provides investment management and financial planning (Note: Sale of this division to Oaktree was announced in September 2024, expected to complete in early 2025).[[1]](https://www.closebrothers.com/what-we-do/savings#:~:text=Not%20what%20you're%20looking%20for?&text=Close%20Brothers%20Savings%2C%20a%20subsidiary,residents%20and%20businesses%20since%202008.)[[2]](https://www.closebrothers.com/annual-report-2024-0#:~:text=Banking%20provides%20specialist%20lending%20and,and%20bridging%20and%20refurbishment%20loans.&text=Close%20Brothers%20Asset%20Management%20%28%22CBAM,of%20certain%20customary%20regulatory%20approvals.&text=Winterflood%20is%20a%20leading%20liquidity,60%20corporate%20clients.)[[3]](https://www.closesavings.co.uk/)[[4]](https://www.closebrothers.com/annual-report-2023)[[5]](https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/uks-close-brothers-sell-winterflood-061940849.html#:~:text=Close%20Brothers%2C%20which%20is%20streamlining%20its%20portfolio,wealth%20managers%2C%20investors%20and%20other%20market%20participants.)

**Recent Developments** 

- **Motor Finance Provision:** The firm has faced share price pressure due to potential costs relating to motor finance redress, as noted by [Sharecast.com](https://www.sharecast.com/news/broker-recommendations/ubs-upgrades-close-brothers-to-buy--22180368.html).
- **Broker Upgrade:** In March 2026, UBS upgraded the firm to 'buy', indicating potential for recovery through restructuring and cost savings, according to Sharecast.com.
- **Market Position:** Close Brothers Group continues to operate as a specialist lender, supporting niche markets in the UK financial ecosystem.[[1]](https://www.sharecast.com/news/broker-recommendations/ubs-upgrades-close-brothers-to-buy--22180368.html#:~:text=UBS%20upgrades%20Close%20Brothers%20to,is%20likely%2C%22%20UBS%20said.)[[2]](https://kalkinemedia.com/uk/stocks/financial/can-close-brothers-shape-ftse-350-path#:~:text=Close%20Brothers%20Group%20%28LSE:CBG%29%20operates%20through%20a%20multi,operating%20within%20the%20FTSE%20universe.)
